hooks.name: pre-compaction-notes
hooks.description: Part E (IDE, CLI v3.1+): before a conversation is compacted, save a snapshot into docs/session-notes.md and tell the summarizer what to keep. Decisions and open questions are written into that file by the agent as they arise.

hooks.name: post-compaction-restore
hooks.description: Part E (IDE, CLI v3.1+): after compaction, re-inject docs/session-notes.md into the conversation.
